{{Top}}
{{Quote|The Supreme Chancellor singles out Mygeeto, Saleucami, and Felucia.''"<br />"''A 'Triad of Evil,' he labeled them.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]|<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>}}
The '''Triad of Evil''' was a propaganda term given by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]], and [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] in his [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] [[State of the Republic address (19 BBY)|State of the Republic address]]. These worlds were bastions of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], against whom the Chancellor's [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was fighting in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-spanning]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. All three planets were located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and became major battlegrounds during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|final sieges]] of the war. Although Palpatine had a strong support bloc in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], the notion of a Triad of Evil was controversial among his opposition, which included the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa's]] anti-war coalition.

Each of the worlds was an important part of the Confederacy of Independent Systems: Felucia housed the headquarters of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], Mygeeto possessed important crystal mines and vaults managed by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], and Saleucami was home to the Confederacy's newly developed underground [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facilities. In his [[State of the Republic address]], Palpatine reassured the populace that the war was nearly won, and that to complete the Republic's victory he was ordering a [[Clone trooper/Legends|troop]] surge in the ongoing Outer Rim Sieges, with specific focus on the worlds of the Triad. In truth, Palpatine was only using the conflicts on these planets as a diversion from the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], which he wished to see [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attacked]] in order to further his goals as the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], Darth Sidious.

==Origin and usage==
{{Quote|Some of us are concerned that the Supreme Chancellor has been persuaded to press these sieges as a means of acquiring worlds by force. There are bills before the Senate now that could grant him the authority to overrule local system governments.|Senator Bail Organa|<ref name="LoE" />}}
[[File:Palpatine-ROTS.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, who coined the term "Triad of Evil"]]
By the [[19 BBY/Legends|third year]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|pan-galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a feeling of imminent victory had ingrained itself within much of the Republic leadership, particularly on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Unbeknown to Republic politicians, both sides of the war were being driven by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic and the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] who directed the Confederacy under his alter ego of Darth Sidious. Palpatine orchestrated the war in order to seize control of the galaxy and destroy the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and so had a vested interest in continuing the conflict until he was certain his plan could come to fruition. In that year, the Republic was able to oust the Confederacy and its [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|armies]] from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] and the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], exiling them back into the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. This led to the chancellor's initiation of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], which tied up vast amounts of Republic military resources and numerous [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] leaders in a fight to the end in the farthest reaches of the galaxy. During this time, a number of Republic [[Senator/Legends|senators]] chose to speak out against Palpatine's [[Enhanced Security and Enforcement Act|security policies]] at home and his war policies abroad. The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] agreed that the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor's office]] should begin work to bring the war to a close, and so Palpatine was forced to distract the public with more specific targets in the Outer Rim.

To that end, the Chancellor used his [[State of the Republic address]] [[State of the Republic address (19 BBY)|that year]] to brand three worlds as a Triad of Evil. The planets&mdash;[[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]], and [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]]&mdash;were all strongholds of the Confederacy, but were noted by members of the Jedi Council to be relatively insignificant when viewed against the backdrop of the entire war. [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], who led the opposition against Palpatine's policies, believed that the chancellor's naming of the Triad of Evil was an attempt to seize Confederate-allied worlds by force. This insinuation was incongruous with the Chancellor's stated intent to focus efforts on planets that were loyal to the Republic but had been taken by the separatists through arms. In his State of the Republic, Palpatine claimed that the Triad was a danger to the body of the Republic, and committed two hundred thousand [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to the targeted worlds, as well as to the rest of the Outer Rim theater. While the violence escalated in those distant regions, Darth Sidious ordered his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], and his subordinate, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], to invade Coruscant and kidnap him as Supreme Chancellor. Grievous was successful in his mission to seize Palpatine, in large part due to the dispersal of Coruscant's [[Coruscant Defense Fleet/Legends|home fleet]] to fight the Confederacy in the Triad of Evil.

==The worlds of the Triad==
===Felucia===
{{Main|Felucia/Legends}}
{{Quote|On Felucia, the Seps dug their metal heels into the muck of that alien hellhole and dared the Republic to come in after them. So we did, only to be met with the month after month of flesh-eating diseases, shrieking nocturnal predators, and other sights that haunt me to this day. Cut off and for all we knew abandoned by our superiors, our only hope was Aayla Secura, our Jedi commander. Without her iron will, none of us would have come out of that mess with our sanity, or our lives.|A [[Retired clone trooper|member]] of the 501st Legion|<ref name="BF2">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Felucia-wide.png|thumb|right|280px|Felucia]]
Felucia, located in the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium sector]] at coordinates R-6, was a humid world covered in thick jungles of [[Fungus/Legends|fungal]] growth. For centuries it had been controlled by the [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], both of which disenfranchised the [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|native]] [[Felucian/Legends|peoples]]. During the Clone Wars, wherein the Commerce Guild allied itself with the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Felucia became a hotly contested world, as it contained the personal holdings of Guild [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] and rested along a vital [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]]. Republic forces managed to gain a foothold on the world around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], but were eventually defeated and driven off the jungle planet by the Confederacy's [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The losses during [[First Battle of Felucia/Legends|this battle]] were heavy for the Republic, but many clone troopers and all of their Jedi commanders were able to escape successfully.

The Republic continued to launch attacks against Felucia throughout the remainder of the war, but never managed to fully seize the world. Despite winning [[Second Battle of Felucia/Legends|another engagement]] later in the conflict, the Republic was unable to retain control of the planet and by the final year of the war, it was again fully controlled by the Confederacy and the Commerce Guild. With the initiation of the Outer Rim Sieges that year, the Republic began broad campaigns to stamp out the Separatist uprising in the galaxy's most distant reaches. Felucia became a major target, and Republic attacks on the world became more frequent and aggressive. Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] forces fortified their positions on the surface, prompting clone infantry to engage their enemy in a [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|messy, months-long campaign]] in the fungal wilderness. The [[182nd Legion]] was among the first Republic units to reach the planet, but quickly fell to Felucia's [[Acklay/Legends|untamed beasts]] and droid defenders. The clones of the elite [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] were sent in to provide reinforcement, but discovered the 182nd had been completely wiped out. A contingent of the 501st stayed on-planet for several [[Standard month/Legends|months]], and fell victim to [[flesh-eating diseases]], local animals, and other difficulties during their tour of duty. They eventually lost contact with their superiors, but were saved by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]]. After Secura and the 501st were rotated out of Felucia, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zonder/Legends|Zonder]] installed themselves in espionage positions within the Commerce Guild workforce.

When the tides of war turned against the Confederacy and Palpatine declared Felucia to be a member of the Triad of Evil, Presidente Shu Mai returned to her world to ensure the successful transfer of her holdings off-planet. During her trip there, her forces captured Offee and Zonder and held them prisoner within the [[Nigkoe Detention Facility/Legends|Nigkoe Detention Facility]]. Their capture prompted the Jedi Order to dispatch Secura to the planet once more, this time as theater commander with the [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]]. Although she and Padawan [[Ekria/Legends|Ekria]] succeeded in freeing their comrades, Mai had long since fled Felucia, in the process activating a self-destructive contingency plan for the world; in her absence, Felucia's water supply would be infected with deadly toxins. While Secura, Offee, Zonder, Ekria, and the newly-arrived Padawan [[Drake Lo'gaan/Legends|Drake Lo'gaan]] attempted to halt the spread of the toxins with the 327th, [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was issued, labeling all Jedi as traitors to the Republic. Although the clone forces succeeded in killing the two elder Jedi, the three Padawans escaped the planet unharmed. The contest for Felucia ended shortly after, with the deactivation of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] and the end of the Clone Wars.

===Mygeeto===
{{Main|Mygeeto/Legends}}
[[File:Mygeetobridgebattle.png|right|220px]]
{{Quote|By the time of the Clone Wars, Mygeeto had become the InterGalactic Banking Clan's second most valuable possession ''[&hellip;]'' The Republic invaded Mygeeto during the Outer Rim Sieges, blanketing the bleached landscape with ash from torpedo bombardments and fuel fires.|An astrographical dossier on Mygeeto|<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>}}
The [[Water/Legends|icy]], [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]]-covered planet of Mygeeto was a major holding of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] prior to and during the Clone Wars. Located at coordinates K-5 in the [[Albarrio sector/Legends|Albarrio sector]], the planet was highly valuable due to its crystalline composition and so became the Banking Clan's second most prized asset, inferior only to the Clan's headquarter world of [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. The [[Muun/Legends|Muuns]] of the IBC secured the world and proceeded to drive the native [[Lurmen/Legends|Mygeetans]] into either hiding or [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]].

===Saleucami===
{{Main|Saleucami/Legends}}
[[File:Saleucamibattleground.jpg|right|220px]]
{{Quote|For five months we've laid siege to Saleucami. We Jedi have led the Republic's clone army against a Morgukai clone army created by the CIS and trained by the Anzati. The siege has prevented the Separatist forces from leaving Saleucami. But the cost in lives has been high, and supplies are thin.|Jedi Master Quinlan Vos|<ref name="Republic74">[[Republic 74|''Republic'' 74]]</ref>}}
After three years of combat experience against the highly-capable clone troopers of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], the Confederate leadership chose to initiate a [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] project of their own. Head of State Dooku selected his [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] protege [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]] to head the operation, headquartered on the arid world of Saleucami.

==Behind the scenes==
The Triad of Evil was referred to in James Luceno's [[2005]] novel ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''. Reviewers have drawn comparisons between Palpatine's mention of the "Triad of Evil" and President [[Wikipedia:George W. Bush|George W. Bush's]] mentions of an "[[Wikipedia:Axis of Evil|Axis of Evil]]" in his [[Wikipedia:2002 State of the Union Address|2002 State of the Union address]].<ref name="tfn">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/books/reviews/r_labyrinthofevil.asp|text=TheForce.Net&ndash;Books&ndash;Reviews&ndash;Labyrinth of Evil by James Luceno|archivedate=20050214010234}}</ref><ref name="Amazon">{{Amazon|url=review/R1YPDZ6QB43Q9I|text=Labyrinth of Evil Customer Review}}</ref>
